claims.text: Multicalibration yields an improvement of +1.03 in brier skill score over uncalibrated token likelihoods.
Multicalibration yields an improvement of +0.37 in brier skill score over baseline calibrations.
Multicalibration captures problem factors such as complexity, code length, and programming language used.

evidence.description: Our results demonstrate that multicalibration can yield distinct improvements over both uncalibrated token likelihoods (+ 1.03 in brier skill score).

methodologies.name: Multicalibration evaluation on function synthesis benchmarks
methodologies.description: Evaluation of four multicalibration approaches capturing problem complexity, code length, and programming language across three function synthesis benchmarks using latest-generation code LLMs.
